title: Phase-Coded Waveform
text: Phase-coded pulse waveform, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of the output, {Phase code} sets the code type used for phase, {Custom phase code}, {Chip width (s)} sets the chip time duration 1e-5, {Number of chips}, {Zadoff-Chu sequence index} sets the sequence index for Zadoff-Chu code type, {Pulse repetition frequency (Hz)} sets the pulse repetition frequency 1e4, {Enable PRF selection input} selects predefined PRF, {Source of Frequency Offset} sets the source of frequency, {Frequency Offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offset, {Source of simulation sample time}, {Output signal format} sets the format of the output, {Number of samples in output}, {Number of pulses in output}, {Enable PRF Output} enables output of PRF, {Enable Matched Filter Coefficients Output} enables output of matched filter and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of the output waveform 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase code
params.values: Code type used for phase modulation Frank (default)

params.name: Custom phase code
params.values: Custom phase code [1,-1] (default) | M -length vector of complex values

params.name: Number of chips
params.values: Number of chips in waveform 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Zadoff-Chu sequence index
params.values: Sequence index for Zadoff-Chu code type 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Source of Frequency Offset
params.values: Source of frequency offset Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Source of simulation sample time
params.values: Source of simulation sample time Derive from waveform parameters (default) | Inherit from Simulink engine

params.name: Output signal format
params.values: Format of the output signal Pulses (default) | Samples

params.name: Number of samples in output
params.values: Number of samples in output 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of pulses in output
params.values: Number of pulses in output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable PRF Output
params.values: Enable output of PRF off (default) | on

params.name: Enable Matched Filter Coefficients Output
params.values: Enable output of matched filter coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
